$schema: One scenario shared by every layout: the same SKUs, the same orders, the same pickers. Layout-specific inputs live under 'layouts'. Every value is an input; nothing here is a result.

skus.label: SKUs
skus.description: Number of SKUs stocked; each one needs its own storage location.

target_locations.label: Storage locations
target_locations.description: Equal capacity: every layout is sized to the smallest footprint with at least this many storage locations.

demand_skew.label: Demand skew
demand_skew.description: Share of order lines that come from the most popular 20% of SKUs.

demand_curve.label: Demand curve
demand_curve.description: Shape of the popularity curve; both put demand_skew % of lines on the top 20% of SKUs. Power gives the single top SKU of 6,000 about 30% of all lines; Bender about 0.3%.

lines_per_order.label: Lines per order
lines_per_order.description: Mean lines per order (geometric distribution: single-line orders are the most common).

peak_hour_factor.label: Peak-hour factor
peak_hour_factor.description: Busiest hour as a multiple of the average hour.

slotting.label: Slotting
slotting.description: How SKUs are assigned to locations.

picker_speed.label: Picker speed
picker_speed.description: Picker travel speed with a cart, including turns and congestion.

lift_speed.label: Lift speed
lift_speed.description: Vertical speed for locations above reach (step ladder or order-picker platform).

reach_height.label: Reach height
reach_height.description: Highest location a picker reaches from the floor without lifting.

pick_time_per_line.label: Pick time per line
pick_time_per_line.description: Time to find, pick and confirm one order line.

order_setup_time.label: Order set-up time
order_setup_time.description: Time per order to take the task, set up the cart and drop the order at the picking point.

picker_efficiency.label: Picker efficiency
picker_efficiency.description: Share of a picker's paid time spent on picking work.

sample_orders.label: Orders sampled
sample_orders.description: Orders sampled to estimate travel (the same orders for every layout).

seed.label: Random seed
seed.description: Random seed for orders and slotting.

building_cost_per_sqm.label: Building cost per m²
building_cost_per_sqm.description: Building shell per m² of floor (the Warehouse Model's default).

shelving_cost_per_location.label: Shelving per location
shelving_cost_per_location.description: WH-B and WH-C: shelving per storage location.

pod_cost.label: Pod price
pod_cost.description: WH-A: one pod (a mobile rack of 16 locations).

robot_cost.label: Robot price
robot_cost.description: WH-A: one drive unit that carries pods.

robot_running_cost_per_year.label: Robot upkeep per year
robot_running_cost_per_year.description: WH-A: upkeep and energy per robot per year.

gtp_station_cost.label: Goods-to-person station
gtp_station_cost.description: WH-A: one goods-to-person picking station (frame, put wall, screens, safety).

pack_station_cost.label: Pack station
pack_station_cost.description: WH-B and WH-C: one pack station at a picking point.

labour_cost_per_hour.label: Pay per hour
labour_cost_per_hour.description: Picker pay per paid hour, all-in.

discount_rate.label: Discount rate
discount_rate.description: Discount rate for turning build costs into equivalent annual costs.

A.$comment: Moving racks (robotic mobile fulfilment). Racks (pods) are sized so a location is about the size of a WH-B/WH-C shelf location (0.6 m wide × 0.6 m deep). Stations and robots are results: as many picker-stations as the peak needs, and the smallest robot fleet that keeps up.

put_away.label: Put-away
put_away.description: Where a robot puts a pod back after picking. Nearest: popular pods come back often, so they gather near the stations. By popularity rank: the slot whose distance rank matches the pod's recent visit rank.

pod_fill.label: Pod fill
pod_fill.description: Which SKUs share a pod. Together: hot and cold pods, so where a pod stands matters. Spread: every pod about equally busy.

bins_per_face_level.label: Bins per face and level
bins_per_face_level.description: Bins (storage locations) per level on each face.

block_length.label: Block length
block_length.description: Pods in a row along a storage block (blocks are 2 pods deep).

robot_aisle_width.label: Robot aisle width
robot_aisle_width.description: Robot aisle width (a loaded robot needs a pod width plus clearance).

storage_fill.label: Storage fill
storage_fill.description: Share of slots holding a pod; the rest stay free so put-away has somewhere to choose.

station_zone.label: Station zone depth
station_zone.description: Depth of the station area along the west wall (stations and their queue lanes).

station_spacing.label: Station spacing
station_spacing.description: Distance between stations along the wall.

aspect.label: Floor proportions
aspect.description: Preferred length:width of the floor (WH-C's default is 1.5).

robot_speed.label: Robot speed
robot_speed.description: Effective robot speed, including acceleration, turns and congestion.

lift_time.label: Lift time
lift_time.description: Time to lift or set down a pod.

pod_switch_time.label: Pod switch time
pod_switch_time.description: Picker time between pods: one leaves, the next moves in and turns to the right face.

order_slots.label: Order slots
order_slots.description: Orders open at a station at once (its put wall).

pipeline.label: Pods per station
pipeline.description: Pods on their way to or queuing at a station at most.

robot_availability.label: Robot availability
robot_availability.description: Share of time a robot is available (the rest is charging).

max_order_wait.label: Longest mean wait
max_order_wait.description: Fleet sizing: robots are added until orders wait no longer than this, on average, for a station.

frequency_half_life_h.label: Popularity memory
frequency_half_life_h.description: By popularity rank: half-life of the smoothed visit counts.

warmup_hours.label: Settling time
warmup_hours.description: Simulated time before measuring (lets put-away settle).

C.$comment: Warehouse Model parameter names (warehouse-model/data/parameters.json); values not listed here take that file's defaults. Shelving for hand picking; picking points on the west wall. warehouse_length/width set the aspect ratio — the building is scaled to target_locations.

B.$comment: Semicircular, person-to-goods. Rack dimensions (rack_height, levels_per_rack, load_height, rack_depth, bay_width, positions_per_level_per_bay, aisle_width, flue_space) and the picking points are taken from layouts.C so the two differ only in arrangement. The outer radius is a result: the building is sized to target_locations.

arrangement.label: Arrangement
arrangement.description: Radial: rack rows point straight out from the picking points. Concentric: rack rows follow arcs, cut by radial aisles.

hub_radius.label: Hub radius
hub_radius.description: Radius of the open floor around the picking points (staging, like WH-C's front cross-aisle).

zones.label: Zones
zones.description: Radial: rings of racking separated by ring cross-aisles. Each ring further out fits more rows.

ring_aisle_width.label: Ring aisle width
ring_aisle_width.description: Radial: width of the ring cross-aisles between zones (and around the outside).

radial_aisles.label: Radial aisles
radial_aisles.description: Concentric: straight aisles leading out from the hub through the rings.

radial_aisle_width.label: Radial aisle width
radial_aisle_width.description: Concentric: width of the radial aisles.
